As a Senior Consultant at Veeva, you will help major pharmaceutical and biotech companies organize and manage their customer and product data. You will design and implement Veeva Network MDM to give clients a single, accurate view of their doctors, hospitals, and business partners across multiple sources.

You will act as the lead solution architect and project driver. You will work directly with clients to understand their needs, design the system setup, and lead a small internal team of technical specialists to build and deliver the solution on time.

How You Will Spend Your Time
50% Data Analysis & Solution Design: Meeting with clients, analyzing their data needs, and designing how the software should be set up.
30% Technical Architecture: High-level platform configuration, mapping data flows, and making sure integrations work correctly.
20% Project Leadership: Keeping projects on schedule, managing risks, and coaching junior team members.

Lead Customer Projects: Run software implementation projects from start to finish for global healthcare and life sciences clients
Design Data Solutions: Set up the platform to track healthcare professionals, organizations, and product data. Help clients combine their internal data sources into a single source of truth
Connect Systems: Connect Veeva Network MDM to Vault CRM so sales teams in the field can easily request data updates and view accurate customer profiles
Configure Portals and Widgets: Set up user-friendly dashboards and widgets so business users can easily search and access the data they need
Advise Stakeholders: Run workshops and present your designs clearly to client managers and stakeholders, translating technical data concepts into plain business language
Improve the Team: Help train junior consultants and create reusable templates and guides to make future implementations faster and better

Consulting Experience: 5+ years of software consulting or professional services experience leading customer-facing technology implementations
MDM Software Skills: 3+ years of hands-on experience configuring Veeva Network MDM or a similar major master data management system (like Reltio or Informatica)
Data Tech Basics: Solid understanding of data integration tools, including SQL, ETL processes, APIs, and CSV/FTP file transfers
Project Delivery: Experience working with structured project timelines (like Agile or Scrum) and managing project tasks
Communication: Excellent presentation and writing skills. You must be comfortable leading meetings and managing client relationships
Travel & Education: Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience) and the ability to travel 20-30% for client meetings
Work Authorization: Must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Veeva does not provide visa sponsorship for this role

Prior experience working in or consulting for the pharmaceutical, biotech, or medical device industries

As a Product Engagement Manager on the User Operations team, you will lead a team of Product Engagement Specialists responsible for ensuring smooth, successful product launches across internal and external teams. You’ll be the glue connecting product teams and support operations, equipping teams with the tools and knowledge needed to support new product rollouts.
You’ll build scalable feedback loops that capture the voice of the user and translate insights into actionable product improvements, and ensure that frontline teams have the knowledge and skills to deliver accurate, delightful customer interactions at scale.
We’re looking for someone who thrives at the intersection of product management, team enablement, and customer advocacy, and who enjoys working cross-functionally in a fast-paced, evolving environment. This person will manage the day-to-day work while also helping architect the systems needed to scale it.
The successful candidate will be a leader-coach who can lead a small team while continuing to perform individual contributor work.
This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

Lead a team coordinating product launches across internal and external teams, ensuring seamless execution and support readiness.
Set the team’s strategy and priorities, translate them into clear goals and quality standards, and allocate capacity to deliver against them.
Build a high-performing team through ongoing coaching, feedback, development, and performance management.
Build out a Voice of the User program with scalable feedback loops between support, Product, and Engineering pre and post launch, so customer insights inform product development and strategy.
Advocate for users by representing their needs and pain points in product and engineering discussions.
Partner with Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Operations to align on launch goals and timelines.
Monitor post-launch performance and gather support data to assess product impact and inform improvements.
Document and standardize launch procedures to make them repeatable and scalable.
Identify launch risks and propose solutions that minimize disruption to customers.
Report on feedback-loop performance, including key insights, trends, and recommendations for the product roadmap.

s.t:
Have experience leading product enablement or launch-readiness functions at scale, particularly in a customer support environment.
Have shipped tooling or automations that reduced manual work and scaled beyond a single team (workflows, dashboards, scripted automation, lightweight pipelines)."
Have experience in product management with automation and tool development, using metrics and feedback to improve decisions and processes.
Build strong cross-functional relationships with Product, Engineering, and Operations teams.
Are passionate about customer advocacy and can translate customer feedback into strategic product insights.
Are highly organized and able to manage multiple projects with competing deadlines.
Communicate technical concepts and customer pain points clearly to diverse audiences.
Take ownership of initiatives from ideation through implementation and post-launch analysis.
Thrive in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities.

Instead, you will act as a dedicated advocate and an internal connector—collaborating directly with Delivery, Sales, and Product leadership to unlock new opportunities, synthesize market insights, and ensure absolute cross-functional accountability across our critical AMP accounts and partnerships.

Help prepare for high-priority customer and partner meetings — crafting thoughtful briefings, coordinating input from internal stakeholders, and ensuring clear follow-up and accountability
Join customer and partner meetings acting as an advocate for the customer and a connector between the Delivery, Sales, and Product teams
Build a deep understanding of MongoDB’s strategic accounts, identifying patterns, opportunities, and challenges that inform company strategy

First 30 Days: Foundation & Alignment
Deep Product & Account Familiarity: Complete onboarding to deeply understand MongoDB's strategic accounts, partner ecosystem, and internal delivery workflows
Relationship Building: Establish strong working relationships with key stakeholders across Sales, Account Executives, Delivery, and Customer Success teams

Meeting Readiness: Independently craft comprehensive briefing materials and coordinate internal stakeholder alignment for high-priority customer and partner meetings
Cross-Functional Orchestration: Serve as an active connector during client sessions, ensuring clear accountability and swift post-meeting follow-up
Market Intelligence: Establish a proactive monitoring cadence for partner announcements and industry signals, successfully identifying new strategic re-engagement windows
First Year: Strategic Impact
Reference & Partner Enablement: Successfully orchestrate the cross-functional coordination required to advance key strategic accounts into fully referenceable champions
Account Acceleration: Directly contribute to revenue and signing milestones by unlocking friction points, identifying patterns, and surfacing actionable insights within strategic accounts
Streamlined Reporting: Fully implement and maintain a predictable reporting framework that gives leadership complete visibility into ongoing project health and partner engagement

Experience: 3–5+ years owning strategic programs portfolios with direct accountability and cross-functional initiatives
Strategic Thinking & Problem Solving: Ability to structure and synthesize ambiguous information into clear insights and actionable recommendations
Customer Orientation: Deep empathy for customer needs and the ability to translate those into business outcomes
Executive Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills; proven ability to interact with senior executives and customers with polish and confidence
Collaboration & Influence: Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to drive alignment across multiple teams
Bias for Action: Thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and has a high sense of urgency to get things done
Technical & Market Acumen: Proficiency with Salesforce and Tableau for data tracking, combined with an interest in software/AI technology and the ability to leverage Generative AI tools for market research and executive briefings

Veeva is building the industry cloud for Life Sciences through software, data, AI, and business consulting working together. Learn more about our products, vision, values, and status as a Public Benefit Corporation (PBC) on our website.

Consulting is changing, and we’re not like other firms. Launched in 2019, Veeva Business Consulting has grown quickly and organically to over 500 global experts who combine deep domain knowledge with innovative technology to help Life Sciences companies work in a more efficient and connected way.

We are growing aggressively as we look towards 2030. We are seeking great people to help shape the future of the industry with the world’s leading software, data, AI, and expertise at their back.

We are hiring recent university graduates to grow the next generation of consultants through our Business Consultant Development Program.

We believe in pushing high potential people to achieve excellence. Our program is specifically designed to provide a challenging environment to learn quickly and deliver value early. You will collaborate with experienced team members on customer-facing engagements to create high-impact business solutions.

In our structured 20 month program, we equip you with the resources to develop the core consulting skills, deep domain expertise, and leadership foundation for long-term career success at Veeva.

Our Business Consulting team builds effective business and operational improvement strategies powered by Veeva’s unique industry insights, and market-leading technology. Our offerings are focused on speeding drug development, launching treatments more effectively, and shaping the best engagement for our customers.

The anticipated start date is October 2027.

Explore More Generation Veeva Roles
We welcome you to apply to all roles that align with your skills and interests. See all open opportunities here: Generation Veeva Careers

Support and deliver all components of customer engagements (e.g., customer communications, workshops, stakeholder interviews, process and data analysis, managing timelines)
Collaborate with Business Consultants to create deliverables that optimize customer operating and engagement models, processes, and business performance
Leverage Veeva’s software and data to pull through tangible business and operational solutions
REQUIREMENTS | We are looking for graduates who meet the following requirements:
Desire to work within an intense, challenging program and environment
Excellent verbal and written communication skills
A process-driven person who loves digging into operations, numbers, and other data to find opportunities for improvement
University degree with strong academic performance
Upcoming university graduate
Fluent in German (professional level) and English
High work ethic. Veeva is a hard-working company
High integrity and honesty. Veeva is a PBC and a “do the right thing” company, and we expect that from all employees

Aufgaben

s.h: Der Job als Consultant bei uns sieht ungefähr wie folgt aus
s.t:
Account Management & Sales: Du lernst bei uns den Kundenkontakt von Grund auf – Cold Calling, Networking, aber auch die Pflege bestehender Kundenbeziehungen gehören zu deinem Gebiet.
Recruiting: Du lernst die HR-Seite aus der Perspektive einer Beratung kennen: Interviews, Assessments, Profiling und Beratungsgespräche.
Projektmanagement: Du arbeitest 360 Grad – das heißt, du übernimmst die Gesamtverantwortung für deine Projekte (sobald du so weit bist). Du betreust sowohl Kunden als auch Kandidaten und stellst am Ende das perfekte Match her.
Qualifikation
Um bei uns erfolgreich zu sein, solltest du Folgendes mitbringen:
Hunger: Das ist ein Sales-Job – wenn du nicht ein bisschen die "Wolf of Wall Street"-Mentalität mitbringst, wird es bei uns schwer. Wir sind alle sehr ambitioniert – die einen träumen vom 911er, die anderen vom Haus auf Bali für Mama und Papa. Jeder hat sein eigenes Ziel – wichtig ist nur, dass du intrinsische Motivation mitbringst.
Sprachliche Fähigkeiten: Deutsch ist ein Muss, Englisch solltest du mindestens auf B2-Niveau sprechen und offen dafür sein, dich eigenständig weiterzuentwickeln.
Disziplin: Die erste Zeit in diesem Job kann hart und anstrengend sein. Wer durchhält, wird am Ende dafür belohnt. Aus eigener Erfahrung kann ich sagen, dass die meisten im ersten Jahr mit einem guten fünfstelligen Bonus rausgehen.
Führerschein: Wäre optimal – Kundenbesuche machen wir meistens vor Ort, oder du fährst die Stopps mit unserem Poolfahrzeug ab.

Ein sehr modernes Büro, Designermöbel und Top-Hardware – wir arbeiten ausschließlich mit Apple-Geräten.
Überdurchschnittliches Gehalt durch verdammt gute Provisionen + Fixgehalt: Wir zahlen dir ein monatliches Fixum, damit du deine Kosten unabhängig von der Provision tragen kannst.
Strukturiertes Onboarding & Mentoring: Du wirst nicht ins kalte Wasser geworfen – erfahrene Consultants nehmen dich an die Hand und bringen dir alles bei, was du brauchst.
Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Wir stehen noch am Anfang unseres Wachstums – eine spätere Führungs- oder Spezialistenrolle ist dementsprechend möglich.
Incentives & Teamreisen: Es gibt regelmäßig die Möglichkeit, dich zu beweisen – dafür haben wir zum Beispiel den 911er-Cup ins Leben gerufen. Einmal im Jahr reisen wir gemeinsam als Team und suchen uns einen coolen Ort für unsere Workation.

Join Deloitte Switzerland-s Third-Party Advisory & Technology Implementation team and empower organisations through technology-enabled transformation journeys
In a world that is constantly driven by emerging risks and technological advances, organisations need to adapt quickly to remain competitive in the market.
The Third Party Advisory and Implementation team assists in identifying, evaluating and mitigating risks associated with external business relationships through advisory, implementation and operate services.

We focus on enhancing the maturity of our client-s third party Management (TPM) processes, covering both third party risk management (TPRM) and contract lifecycle management (CLM) activities. This includes setting up Third Party Management frameworks to deploying technologies to manage third party relationships.

The Third Party Advisory team drives the growth of TPRM and CLM technology implementations across industries by building strong relationships with leading vendors and combining deep product knowledge with market leading TPRM and CLM strategy and design expertise.
**How you can make an impact**
We have a new and exciting opportunity for someone to join our Zurich-based team as a Technology Solution Senior Consultant, to help support the growth of our implementation capability and deliver complex large-scale technology transformation journeys.
The role would involve working directly with senior leaders within the team to deliver the implementation of cloud-based SaaS TPRM and/or CLM solutions to clients, including the integration of these solutions with existing client platforms.
In addition, the role will provide a great opportunity to develop leading methodologies for delivery of these implementation projects and to support eminence activity with key TPRM and CLM technology vendors.

As a Third Party Advisory and Technology Solution Senior Consultant with experience of large-scale technology implementations, you will have responsibility for:
* Analysing a client-s TPRM and/or CLM processes, and providing advisory services to enhance their existing ways of working
* Supporting clients in technology capability assessments, and identifying configuration and integration opportunities for the client-s selected TPRM and/or CLM technology
* Translating business requirements into technology capabilities, and developing an end-to-end implementation plan based on the TPRM and/or CLM technology selected, including configuration plans, UAT scripts, and integration strategies
* Supporting the business and technical teams during design, build, test and deployment phases of a TPRM and/or CLM Technology Implementation
* Configuring and build integration solutions that meet the client-s business requirements
* Leading delivery of detailed integration architecture including software and infrastructure components - considering functionality, data, security, integration, infrastructure and performance
* Creating and maintaining technical documentation where required for the implementation

* Technical solution experience, ideally on large scale, complex cloud-based SaaS implementations
* Specific experience with configuring and implementing market leading TPRM or Contract Management Technologies (e.g. OneTrust, ProcessUnity, ServiceNow, Icertis, Sirion, DocuSign)
* In-depth understanding of the different integration vendors and technologies, and key differences between these
* Experience of acting within a Solution Architect role and proven expertise in an IT development background.
* Knowledge of artificial intelligence (AI) capabilities, with the ability to leverage AI-driven insights within daily tasks
* Knowledge or experience working in the area of Risk Consulting and/or professional services will be considered an advantage
* Fluency in English is mandatory; German would be considered an advantage

EDB is seeking a Consultant/Senior Consultant to join our Professional Services team in EMEA. This is a dual-level role: candidates with 2–5 years of relevant experience will be considered at Consultant level, while those with 5–8+ years of DBA or data engineering experience will be considered at Senior Consultant level.
This is a customer-facing, technically hands-on role spanning two core disciplines: Postgres database consulting (migrations, HA/DR, performance tuning, DBA advisory) and modern data engineering (data pipelines, analytics platforms, AI/ML integration).

The ideal candidate brings strength in one discipline and credible working knowledge of the other — enabling them to serve EDB's expanding EMEA customer base across traditional enterprise database workloads and next-generation AI and analytics use cases.
Assess existing customer deployments of Postgres and associated tools; develop recommendations and document required technical steps in clear runbooks.
Perform database migrations from Oracle, SQL Server and/or MySQL to PostgreSQL — schema conversion, data migration, PL/SQL remediation.
Design, implement and test High Availability configurations using PostgreSQL: EFM, Patroni and PGD (Active/Active) architectures.
Perform performance tuning for existing database deployments: queries, database configuration and OS-level optimisation.
Implement backup and recovery strategies (Barman, WAL archiving, PITR); perform upgrades and patching.
Evaluate customer security requirements and make recommendations covering authentication, encryption and access control.
Work with customers to upgrade applications to the latest version of Postgres and configure them to take advantage of new features.
Develop Professional Services proposals that address customer needs and targets; contribute to the PS pre-sales process.
Partner with clients to implement scalable data engineering pipelines, data models, data warehouses and analytics platforms from inception to deployment.
Set up and configure underlying data infrastructure — storage, compute clusters, cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks) — and identify performance tuning opportunities.

The International Water Management Institute (IWMI) is an international non-profit, research-for-development organization that works with governments, civil society, and private sector organizations to address water-related challenges in developing countries and scale up solutions.

IWMI is headquartered in Colombo, Sri Lanka, and is a CGIAR research center with offices in 15 countries and a global network of researchers operating in approximately 56 countries. IWMI is implementing a regional project focused on Resilient Nature-Based Water Solutions (RNBWS) in Jordan, Egypt, Palestine, and Lebanon.

Related projects are also being implemented in Iraq, Bangladesh, and Sudan. The projects include environmental, agricultural, and social interventions, including the following examples:
Solar-powered irrigation systems for agriculture in Egypt.
A small-scale food processing enterprise supporting rural women and smallholder female farmers, known as Nawalla.
Rehabilitation of irrigation canals and springs.
A training manual on gender-transformative curricula, including the delivery of the associated training course.
As part of its strategy to mobilize innovative finance and scale these interventions, IWMI seeks to explore the tokenization of these assets as digital instruments.

Tokenization—the process of representing ownership or value rights of real-world assets on a blockchain or distributed ledger—may offer potential pathways for attracting impact investors, improving transparency, and enabling fractional ownership.

Given the nascent and evolving legal and regulatory landscape for digital assets across Jordan, Egypt, Palestine, Bangladesh, and Sudan, specialized legal and regulatory expertise is required to assess feasibility, structure compliant instruments, and guide the token issuance process.

OBJECTIVE OF THE ASSIGNMENT: The objective of this consultancy is to provide technical advisory services to the Al Murunah and Al Murunah+ projects to assess the feasibility of, and develop a business model and roadmap for, the tokenization of the projects’ nature-based solution assets in Jordan, Egypt, and Palestine.

The Consultant is expected to advise IWMI on the selection of assets for tokenization, identify the potential benefits and incentives of tokenization, and deliver actionable guidance on structuring compliant digital asset instruments in accordance with applicable national laws and relevant international frameworks.

The assignment will be considered successful if, upon its completion, IWMI is able to make an informed Go/No-Go decision on piloting tokenization in at least one priority jurisdiction, supported by a legally compliant structuring option, a documented risk framework, and enhanced internal staff capacity to engage credibly with regulators and investors.

The consultancy will also demonstrate the potential value of tokenization through the following outcomes:
Improved access to impact investment: Tokenization will enable owners of assets, such as solar-powered irrigation systems, the Nawalla food processing enterprise, and rehabilitated irrigation canals, to attract a broader pool of impact investors by representing these assets as digital instruments.
Fractional ownership: Tokenization enables assets to be divided into smaller, investable units, lowering the entry barrier for investors and potentially broadening the funding base significantly. This is particularly relevant to strengthening women’s ownership of assets and enhancing their ability to use those assets as collateral.
Transparency and accountability: Blockchain-based instruments improve the traceability of how funds are utilized and how assets perform, thereby informing IWMI’s engagement with future donors and investors.
Scalability: A proven tokenization model in Jordan, Egypt, and Palestine could be replicated in other project countries, including Iraq, Bangladesh, and Sudan, thereby multiplying its impact.
Intellectual property (IP) monetization: Explore how non-physical outputs, such as the gender-transformative training manual, could generate ongoing revenue through tokenized licensing and royalty structures.
DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES: Task 1: Inception Meeting The Consultant will hold a brief inception meeting with the Al Murunah/Al Murunah+ project teams to provide a baseline understanding of tokenization and the expected deliverables throughout the duration of the assignment. This meeting will also be used to test and refine the asset selection criteria. Task 2: Overall Regulatory Landscape Assessment
Conduct a rapid and comprehensive review of the legal and regulatory environment for digital assets and tokenization in Jordan, Egypt, and Palestine, covering:
Applicable securities, financial instruments, and fintech legislation in each jurisdiction.
Central bank regulations and digital asset frameworks (including regulatory sandbox programs, where available).
Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Know Your Customer (KYC) requirements relevant to digital asset issuance.
Cross-border digital asset transaction rules applicable to the three countries.
Gaps, risks, and enabling conditions within each regulatory environment.
Task 3: Establish Asset Selection Criteria
Work with the project team to gain a better understanding of the available assets and establish a structured asset evaluation framework.
Provide an analysis and recommendations for structuring a business model for one or more of the following assets as tokenized digital instruments:
Solar-powered irrigation systems: Assess options for tokenizing physical infrastructure assets (e.g., revenue-sharing tokens and asset-backed tokens).
Food processing enterprise (Nawalla): Assess options for equity-like or utility token structures representing operational value or returns.
Spring and/or irrigation canal rehabilitation.
Training manual: Assess intellectual property (IP) tokenization options, including licensing rights and royalty structures.
For each asset, the analysis should identify the most appropriate token type (utility, security, or hybrid), legal vehicle, and jurisdiction for issuance.
Task 4: Develop a Business Model for Tokenization
For the selected assets, design a business model for tokenization, followed by an online consultative meeting with the project team.
Develop a compliance framework for the digital asset issuance process, including:
Investor eligibility and accreditation requirements for each jurisdiction.
Disclosure and prospectus obligations (where applicable).
Information requirements related to the identified interventions.
Data protection and cybersecurity considerations.
Environmental and social safeguard requirements linked to nature-based solutions standards.
A risk register identifying key legal, regulatory, and reputational risks.
Task 5: Tokenization Roadmap / Implementation Plan
Prepare a phased implementation roadmap for the tokenization of the identified assets, including:
Recommended sequencing of asset tokenization (short-, medium-, and long-term).

About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

Anthropic is building AI systems that will shape the trajectory of one of the most consequential technologies in human history. That work requires physical infrastructure at significant scale, and building that infrastructure the right way means being a real, long-term partner to the communities where we operate.
We are looking for a Community Engagement Manager in Texas to join our Public Policy team and serve as Anthropic's on-the-ground presence in the communities where our data centers are sited, built, and operated. This is not a communications role or a government affairs role, though you will do elements of both. It is a relationship role: your job is to make Anthropic a trusted, visible, and valued neighbor, from the earliest stages of site selection through construction and long-term operations.
You will be the connective tissue between Anthropic's Policy and Infrastructure teams and the local officials, community organizations, economic development partners, and residents who have a stake in what we build.

You will surface concerns before they escalate, translate our technical and operational plans into clear local benefits, and build the coalitions that allow us to move quickly and responsibly.

Because Anthropic's infrastructure footprint is still early in its growth, you will also help write the playbook: the processes you build in your first markets are the ones we will use as we expand.
You will travel regularly within your region, up to 50% of the time, and occasionally to other Anthropic data center markets.

We are looking for a Community Engagement Manager in Australia to join our Public Policy team and serve as Anthropic's on-the-ground presence in the communities where our data centres are sited, built, and operated. Leadership At Komodo Health
Mavens is a Komodo Health company focused on delivering Salesforce-based solutions that drive workflow and digital engagement across the life sciences industry. The Mavens Managed Services team partners closely with our customers post initial implementation to support long term success with our solutions. Our managed services team serves as trusted advisors who understand both the evolving technology and the business challenges our customers face.
Managed Services Consultants are the primary long-term partners for our customers, acting as a fully integrated extension of the customer’s IT team. They balance day-to-day administrative support with complex release management, ensuring that applications are functioning properly to support business-critical processes. They play a strategic role in building and maintaining strong customer relationships and continuously seek opportunities to further assist customers with their evolving needs.
The ideal candidate is a goal-oriented and self-motivated individual who is comfortable working in fast-paced work environments. They demonstrate strong collaboration skills by working effectively across internal teams and with customers to drive shared outcomes.

They hold themselves accountable to commitments and follow through with a high degree of ownership. They bring creativity and resourcefulness to problem-solving, finding practical solutions in ambiguous or complex situations. They approach interactions with empathy, fostering trust with both customers and colleagues.
The Opportunity at Mavens
Communications & Project Management
Lead Stakeholder Engagement: Lead weekly status calls, third-party vendor alignments, and design reviews.
Manage Project Documentation: Prepare status call content (dashboards, agendas) and manage the RAIL (Rolling Action Item Log) by creating and updating items in real-time.
Release Planning: Create and maintain release timelines and support customers with release candidate prioritization.
Governance & Business Planning: Provide technical recommendations and work in collaboration with customers to define a clear roadmap.
Internal Collaboration: Maintain clear and proactive communication with internal stakeholders - including practice leads, consultants, developers, architects, and QA - to share customer context, coordinate delivery activities, and surface risks or escalations through the appropriate channels.

Analyze Business Needs: Prepare for and lead requirements gathering sessions.
Technical Implementation: Assess Level of Effort (LOE) for functional items and complete or delegate build/configuration changes.
DevOps & Deployment: Manage repositories and promote completed build to higher environments.
Maintain Documentation: Manage requirements, test cases, functional and technical guides, integration specifications, and other application documentation.
Testing & Quality Assurance
Validation: Perform System Integration Testing (SIT) and provide guidance/support for User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
Spot Checks: Validate deployments by checking changes in higher environments.
Ongoing Support & Maintenance
User & Data Management: Handle user lifecycle (creation, deactivation, permissions) and maintain data integrity (duplicate management, record updates).
Issue Management: Investigate reported issues, monitor error reports, and triage/escalate problems as needed to ensure resolution.
Reporting: Create and update reports and perform data extractions/exports for the customer.
Competencies
Platform Expertise: Strong knack for understanding how applications work and envisioning solutions on the Force.com platform.
Functional Advisory: Ability to provide "how-to" technical assistance and advise customers on product features and enhancements.
Communication Skills: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to seamlessly connect and translate between technical and non-technical audiences.
Documentation Mastery: Experience authoring requirements, system specifications, and application guides.
Project Management: Understanding of core project management concepts, including timeline management and LOE assessment.
Industry Knowledge: Life Sciences or Pharmaceutical experience is a significant plus.
Education & Certification: Bachelor’s degree preferred; Salesforce Certification is required.

Ob bei der Gestaltung zukunftsfähiger Organisationen, der Erschliessung neuer Potenziale durch Daten und KI oder der Absicherung von Unternehmen durch ganzheitliche Cybersicherheit: Wir liefern Resultate pragmatisch und zielgerichtet.

An den Schweizer Standorten Zürich, Bern und Lausanne arbeiten rund 450 Mitarbeitende.
# **Das ist der Job - Deine Hauptaufgaben** #
* Strategische Cross-Industry-Beratung bei der Implementierung neuer regulatorischer Vorgaben (Anforderungen definieren, Gap-Analyse durchführen, Handlungsfelder aufzeigen und Massnahmen umsetzen)
* Beratung unserer Kunden vorrangig in folgenden Rechtsgebieten: (Gen)AI Governance & Compliance, Vertrags- und Lizenzrecht, Contract Design, Datenschutz und Informationssicherheit, Third-Party-Risk-Management, Cybersecurity, FINMA-Vorgaben, etc. mit Fokus auf Fragestellungen im Zusammenhang mit digitaler Transformation
* Übernahme von Verantwortung in Teilprojekten sowie Unterstützung bei der Planung, Steuerung und Umsetzung komplexer Kundenprojekte
* Aktive Mitgestaltung beim Ausbau des internationalen Legal Strategy Teams
* Industrieübergreifende Projekttätigkeit mit der Möglichkeit, sich in einer Branche vertiefte Expertise aufzubauen
# **Dieser Job ist für dich, wenn** #
* Du erfolgreich ein Studium der Rechtswissenschaften oder Wirtschaftsrecht abgeschlossen hast.
* Du mind. 2 Jahre Erfahrung an der Schnittstelle von Recht, Technologie und IT hast und idealerweise bereits in Digitalisierungs-, Compliance-, Datenschutz-, Cybersecurity- oder Transformationsprojekten mitgearbeitet hast.

Founded in 2004, BME Strategies is a Massachusetts-based consulting firm specializing in the design, implementation, and evaluation of public health programs for local, regional, and state government partners.

Our work supports evidence-based, community-driven solutions that strengthen public health systems and advance equity across the communities we serve. At BME, our clients are on the front lines of Public Health. Priorities may shift but our commitment to supporting our partners does not.

BME Strategies is seeking a Consultant, Change Management to lead our clients through the “people side” of organizational transformation. The person in this role will be a strategic partner to public health departments and nonprofits, moving beyond checklist-style project management to ensure that new policies, technologies (including AI), and protocols are deeply embedded and sustained by the workforce.
A key focus of this role is guiding local health partners through the adoption of AI-enabled tools and workflows, translating technical capability into practical, trusted practice on the ground. As an example, someone in this role may focus on why a deadline is missed, investigate human constraints like burnout or capacity gaps, and build the inclusive communication loops necessary to maintain organizational resilience.

Consultant roles at BME consist of approximately 85% project work, 5% administrative work, and 10% business development.
Leads or co-leads larger projects, technical and advisory, and contributes to project design.
Independently driving work with minimal day-to-day/project oversight.

Manages projects to exemplary client satisfaction.

Transformation Leadership & Strategy: Lead the “People Side” of large-scale initiatives, ensuring that digital, operational, and AI-driven transitions are met with high adoption and minimal resistance.
Human-Centered Journey Mapping: Design and facilitate journey mapping sessions to identify friction points for frontline staff and stakeholders, ensuring implementation plans are grounded in the practitioner’s reality.
Strategic Stakeholder Engagement: Identify exactly who needs buy-in and partner with our Strategic Communications team to craft data-driven narratives that foster trust and alignment.
Workforce Development & Coaching: In partnership with our Workforce Development Team, provide hands-on coaching and upskilling to local leaders and staff, fostering long-term autonomy rather than temporary support.
Change Impact & Readiness Assessments: Conduct qualitative and quantitative assessments to evaluate organizational readiness and the magnitude of change, specifically within rural and urban health settings.
AI Change Management & Local Partner Support: Serve as a trusted advisor to local health departments, community health centers, and other local health partners as they adopt AI-enabled tools and workflows, translating technical AI capabilities into practical, human-centered guidance, addressing staff concerns about trust, data privacy, and job impact, and ensuring responsible, equity-centered adoption at the point of care and service delivery.

Master’s degree in Public Health or a related field.

Experience in organizational change management or public health leadership and consulting.

As a Senior Consultant in the Tech M&A cohort of our Deal Transformation practice, you will support corporate and private equity clients in understanding the technology dimension of their most important transactions.

Technology has become one of the defining value drivers in M&A-it shapes deal theses, influences valuation, creates integration and separation complexity, and ultimately determines how value is protected and delivered after close.

With AI accelerating change across industries, you will help clients assess technology opportunities, risks and disruption while supporting informed deal decisions and long-term value creation.

* **Technology due diligence**: Assess technology landscapes, applications, infrastructure, cloud, data, cybersecurity, operating models and technology spend to identify transaction risks and opportunities.
* **Technology integrations and carve-outs**: Support technology separation and integration planning, including Day 1 readiness, TSA considerations, target-state design and implementation planning.
* **Technology strategy and value creation**: Analyse technology strategy, AI impact, operating model improvements and value creation opportunities across the transaction lifecycle.
* **Technology cost and synergy analysis**: Support technology cost assessments, synergy analysis and investment planning while working closely with financial and commercial deal teams.
* **Client delivery**: Translate complex technology findings into clear analyses and executive-ready recommendations while collaborating with multidisciplinary deal team

* Entrepreneurial mindset with a strong interest in technology, M&A and value creation; curiosity for emerging technologies.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to simplify complex technology topics.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree from a leading university.
* Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in M&A, technology strategy, technology transformation, transaction advisory or a related industry role.
* Strong acumen for project and stakeholder management with paired with high-quality skills in Excel, PowerPoint and executive storytelling. Fluency in English. German and/or French is desired.

As Commercial Strategy Analyst, you'll be part of the engine behind Halter's strategic decisions. You'll be building models, sizing opportunities, and running qualitative and quantitative analysis that shows us where to play. When the Commercial Strategy team needs to know whether a bet is worth making, they'll come to you to help build the case.
This is a role for someone who loves getting into the data and building up research. You'll turn ambiguous questions into clean, decision-ready analysis: market and opportunity sizing, scenario and sensitivity analysis, competitor analysis and broader industry trends. You'll make the complex feel simple, and give the team clear answers they can act on fast.
You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with Halter's commercial, finance, and product teams, supporting the initiatives that shape our future. You'll move between deep-focus analysis at your desk, pulling data from across the business, as well as getting out to meet farmers and ranchers so your thinking is grounded in reality.

Own the quantitative analysis that underpins the Commercial Strategy team's decisions.
Source and analyse the information we need to help answer questions like where to play and how to win.
Pull together market data, competitive intelligence, and macro trends to keep our analysis current.
Support opportunity assessments for new markets, partnerships, and monetisation models with the sizing and financial structure behind them.
Translate your analysis into clear, concise charts and narratives that execs and frontline teams can quickly act on.

We’re looking for a Senior Commercial Strategy Analyst to join our Commercial FP&A team. This isn't a traditional "back-office" finance role. You will sit at the intersection of commercial strategy and technical data execution. You’ll be responsible for translating complex unit economics into growth levers, leveraging modern tooling and AI to automate the mundane and focus on the "why."

Commercial Performance Engine: Partner with brand leads to interrogate daily performance. You won’t just report on CAC; you’ll analyze the marginal return on spend across multi-channel funnels.
Advanced Financial Architecture: Maintain and scale complex, driver-based financial models. You’ll be expected to bridge the gap between high-level P&L targets and granular operational data.
AI-Driven Efficiency: Integrate AI and automation (e.g., LLM-assisted data cleaning, Python scripts, or advanced ChatGPT workflows) to accelerate reporting cycles and predictive forecasting.
Unit Economics Deep-Dives: Deconstruct LTV/CAC ratios, payback periods, and cohort retention profiles to advise on capital allocation across different geographies.
Data Synthesis: Work closely with the Data team to ensure our "Source of Truth" is robust, moving beyond static sheets into dynamic, real-time dashboards.
Scenario & Sensitivity Analysis: Build "stress-test" models to evaluate the impact of supply chain shifts, pricing elasticity, and new market entry variables.
Operational Partnering: Act as a financial co-pilot for the Marketing and Operations teams, translating their roadmaps into headcount plans and Opex budgets.

3-6 years of experience in a high-intensity analytical environment. Backgrounds in Investment Banking, high-growth companies or similar are highly valued.
Strong FP&A and commercial finance foundation with experience supporting business performance through financial modeling, forecasting, and strategic analysis.
Experience within D2C, B2C, consumer, subscription , or high-growth commercial environments is strongly preferred.
Strong understanding of commercial and customer metrics including:
CAC (Customer Acquisition Cost)
LTV (Lifetime Value)
Retention and cohort analysis
Revenue performance and unit economics
The "Full-Stack" Analyst: You possess a rare combination of commercial intuition and technical rigor. You can discuss brand strategy with a GM and SQL joins with a Data Engineer in the same hour.
Technical Mastery: Expert-level Excel/Google Sheets is a baseline. Proficiency (or a strong desire to learn) SQL, Python, or data visualization tools (Looker/Tableau) is essential.
AI Native: You are proactive in using AI tools to enhance your productivity, from automating spreadsheet workflows to synthesizing large data sets.
Precision & Speed: You have the "IB-style" attention to detail where every decimal point matters, but the startup speed to ship an 80/20 analysis when the business needs to move fast.
Strong Communication: The ability to turn a sea of data into a 3-bullet-point executive summary that drives action.

It’s an exciting time to be joining Ogilvy Consulting. As we grow, we’re looking for a Senior Consultant to join our Marketing Transformation practice.

They help clients understand how marketing organisations, capabilities, ways of working and operating models need to evolve to unlock growth, improve effectiveness and respond to a digitally led, AI-enabled world.
This role requires experience in supporting and delivering marketing transformation work. We work across areas such as organisational design, target operating model definition, change management, capability building, process mapping, employee experience and AI advisory. Senior Consultants play a critical role in translating this thinking into practical workstreams, high-quality deliverables and clear recommendations that clients can act on.

Owning discrete workstreams within wider marketing transformation projects, working independently with appropriate oversight and directing junior team members where required.
Supporting the design and delivery of transformation work across operating model design, organisational design, change management, capability building, process mapping, employee experience and AI-enabled marketing transformation.
Collaborating with colleagues across the Consulting team and the wider Ogilvy and WPP network to solve high-profile challenges for our clients.
Applying relevant consulting methodologies to structure analysis, frame hypotheses, build recommendations and create high-quality client deliverables.
Building trusted working relationships with mid-level client teams, confidently facilitating meetings, leading interviews, capturing key insights and helping maintain momentum across project activities.
Participating in strategic new business pitches and initiatives, including preparing sections of proposals and identifying add-on opportunities within existing client relationships.
Keeping abreast of developments in marketing transformation, modern operating models, organizational change, AI and marketing effectiveness, actively contributing to the team’s knowledge base and thought leadership.
Acting as a role model for your grade, supporting Analysts and Consultants, helping onboard new colleagues and contributing to a positive, inclusive and high-performing project environment.

At least 5 years of experience in consulting, client-side strategy, marketing transformation, organizational change or a related field.
Emerging specialist expertise in one or more areas of marketing transformation such as operating model design, organizational design, change management, capability building, employee experience, process design or AI-enabled marketing transformation.
Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to synthesise quantitative and qualitative inputs, identify key trends and develop clear, actionable recommendations.
Ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a high-performing team.
Understanding of, and interest in, behavioural science and the principles of behaviour change.
Able to prepare and lead client interviews, workshops and meetings, using active listening to draw out insight, align stakeholders and move teams toward practical outcomes.
Comfort challenging conventional views and presenting ideas persuasively to gain buy-in from clients and colleagues.
A strong understanding of modern marketing organisations and how brands, capabilities, technology, data, process and culture come together to drive growth and effectiveness.
Curiosity about AI and its impact on marketing transformation, with the ability to identify opportunities to use AI tools and methodologies to improve insight, efficiency and project workflows.
Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the energy, pragmatism and flexibility to thrive in a fast-moving consulting environment.
About Ogilvy Consulting
Ogilvy Consulting is different from other consultancies: we bridge strategy and execution, rigour and creativity. We are nestled at the heart of Ogilvy and the broader WPP network, which means we can bring together consulting, creative, data, technology, media and experience expertise to help clients move from strategy to implementation.

Identificar las oportunidades de alto valor en los clientes a nivel de optimización y mejora de sus indicadores de: colocación, riesgo, cartera vencida, deserción. Asimismo, proponer modelos analíticos, políticas y estudios que permitan optimizar la operación del cliente

Apoyar el proceso de venta de consultoría con base en su experiencia y visión de negocio para ayudar al cliente a entender el valor que Experian proporciona a través de sus solucione

Compartir experiencia y conocimiento a través de las mejores prácticas existentes locales y globales para acompañar a los clientes en sus objetivos de negocio

Desarrollar la propuesta de valor a los clientes incluyendo claramente los retos estratégicos del cliente, como los productos/soluciones que podrían aportar al desarrollo de la estrategia y como estos impactarían a los resultados
